jobs.title: Equipment Operator
jobs.description: Equipment Operator This job may guide a crew of equipment operators and oversees daily activities related to program delivery within a designated highway area. The role involves operating and maintaining heavy-duty equipment used in road maintenance, including trucks, brooms, packers, oil distributors, loaders, graders, stripers, and cranes. It provides on-site supervision by assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and ensuring work is completed safely and efficiently. The position may also require operating road equipment, directing traffic in challenging roadway conditions and severe weather, and travelling extensively throughout the province. A valid Class 1A driver’s license is required, and the role involves physically and mentally demanding work, including heavy lifting, climbing, and sustained physical labour.
